theme_archetype: JEWEL & LUXURY meets SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Cinematic, Intellectual, Dark, Glowing)

rules.headings: Large, cinematic, tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Break symmetry.
rules.body: Clean, highly legible, leading-relaxed for long-form reading.
rules.accents: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs font-bold for section overlines.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-32), allowing content to breathe and emphasizing dramatic scale.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Used in About and Previous Events. Asymmetrical spans to create visual tension.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Crystal Glass for headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Subtle 1px inner borders.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling using Framer Motion whileInView.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-2), drop-shadow glows (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(230,43,30,0.4)]), images scale up 105%.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up animations on scroll using Framer Motion (initial: opacity 0, y: 30).
motion_and_interactions.particles: Floating 'ember' particles moving upwards slowly in the Hero section to simulate sparks.

3d_and_visual_effects.particles_library: react-tsparticles and tsparticles (lightweight glowing red/orange dots).
3d_and_visual_effects.gradients: Radial gradients (bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))]) from-ted_red/20 to-transparent used to create soft stage lighting behind key elements.

components.navbar: Sticky glassmorphism nav. Contains combined TEDx + Amity logo lockup. Transparent to black blur on scroll.
components.hero: h-screen, absolute particle canvas. Massive central dramatic typography: 'One Spark... Endless Possibilities'.
components.about: Asymmetrical layout. Left side: large elegant serif text. Right side: cinematic event photo.
components.events: Grid of cards with glowing red hover effects. Cinematic imagery.
components.speakers: Grid of speaker cards. Default grayscale imagery, transitioning to full color and scaling up on hover. Click triggers Shadcn Modal overlay with deep black background.
components.registration: Massive CTA block. Includes a large countdown timer in Playfair Display. Primary red pill-shaped button.
components.team: Minimalist card grid. Professional photos, clean typography, tiny LinkedIn icons.
components.sponsors: Sleek 'Coming Soon' placeholder with subtle pulsing text effect.
components.footer: Deep padding, massive TEDx logo text at the bottom, social links arrayed cleanly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute yarn add framer-motion lucide-react react-tsparticles tsparticles
Add fonts Playfair Display and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html.
Build strictly in React (.js). Export components properly.
Configure tailwind.config.js with colors: { brand: { red: '#E62B1E', ember: '#ff4d2e' } }.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for everything; use #0a0a0a for card backgrounds to separate from the #000000 base.
Implement the sticky navbar with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-black/60. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for scrolling headers.
Apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, modals).
Ensure particle canvas stays behind content (z-0) and doesn't block pointer events for buttons.
TEDx Logo requirement: Use text with formatting - TEDxAmityUniversityBengaluru.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Components MUST use named exports, Pages MUST use default exports.
